allow: PowerShell(Get-AppxPackage | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'Claude|Anthropic' } | Select-Object Name, PackageFullName, InstallLocation, Status, Version | Format-List)

PowerShell($paths = @\("$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\AnthropicClaude", "$env:APPDATA\\Claude", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\Claude", "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude"\); foreach \($p in $paths\) { if \(Test-Path $p\) { $i = Get-Item $p; "EXISTS: $p  \(modified $\($i.LastWriteTime\)\)" } else { "missing: $p" } })
